units: USD per insured acre per year
crops: principal crops = corn + soybeans + wheat + sorghum (RMA); corn also given separately

diversity_metric.name: share_3plus
diversity_metric.label: share of cropland in 3+ crop rotations (CDL, 5-year window 2019-2023)

slider_effect.label: Scenario assumption, not an estimate from the county data: field trials (Bowles et al. 2020) found 14-90% smaller maize drought-year yield losses in diversified rotations. est = trial lower bound (14%); lo = no effect (the county data show no robust effect); hi = trial upper bound (90%).
slider_effect.form: fields moved from simple to 3+ crop rotations lose r less in drought years: county drought loss multiplier m(s) = (1 - r*s) / (1 - r*s_now), s = share of cropland in 3+ crop rotations

notes: Expected bill = mean of 44 simulated years (NASA POWER hazard 1981-2024 applied to today's county characteristics); 1-in-5 / 1-in-10 = 80th / 90th percentile. lo/hi = 5th-95th percentile over 100 block-bootstrap refits (parameter uncertainty).
actual = RMA drought indemnity per insured acre that year (nominal); hindcast = out-of-time prediction from the model trained on 2001-2020.
taxpayer_expected_bill = subsidy_share x expected_bill (actuarial approximation: premiums are set to cover expected losses, and the federal subsidy pays subsidy_share of premiums).
